summary: Frontend-only check of the landing page layout reorder. I measured each section's bounding box at 1920, 1536, 1280, 1024, 768 and 390 px. At 1920 and 1536 the order matches the mockup exactly. Hero, then quick-features (6 items in one row), then use-cases (left) and how-it-works side by side at the same top, then features (left) and see-in-action side by side, then live-preview at full width, then pricing (left) and social-proof side by side, then final-cta, then footer. Gaps are 20px and the pairwise box check found no overlaps. At 1280 and 1024 the same rows hold. How-it-works steps stack vertically at 1024 (lg) and sit horizontally at 1280 (xl). At 768 and 390 all 11 blocks stack in the same order with no horizontal scroll (scrollWidth equals clientWidth). The only wider elements are clipped decorative glows. Quick-features shows 6 across at 768 and 3x2 at 390. Functional checks: see-in-action-watch, see-in-action-thumb and hero-live-demo each scroll #live-preview to top=80. kousik-profile-card shows 'Kousik Kar' and '@kousik'. The posts, chat and product tabs switch. All 4 profile-indicator-* render with 4 SVG connector paths at 1920. Hovering indicator-2 makes its path solid at width 2.5, dims the others to 0.35 opacity and adds ring-2. plan-card-free/creator/pro/business render. The currency toggle works (Pro: INR ₹1,699, USD $19). testimonial-next and testimonial-prev work in 3 of 3 runs. hero-create-avatar, final-cta-create-account and header-create-account each open the signup modal, and Escape closes it. Nav links features, use-cases, live-preview and pricing scroll to their targets. Pricing stops at top 285 because the page cannot scroll further. No page errors.

issues: The left copy column is vertically centred in a roughly 790px-tall banner, which leaves a lot of empty purple space above and below the heading. Cosmetic only.
The handle '@businessmentor' is truncated and its verified badge is partly clipped at the card edge. Minor.

action_items: LOW: The docblock comment at the top of LandingPage.tsx (lines 16-23) still describes the old bento layout ('Row 3: Features grid + Pricing (left) · Live @kousik profile + Social proof (right)'). Update it to the new row order.
LOW (optional): Tighten the live-preview vertical padding on xl screens, and let the use-case handle text wrap or shrink at lg so the badge is not clipped.
critical_code_review_comments: The layout code is clean: each row is its own WRAP grid with lg two-column templates, the order in the DOM matches the visual order, and no CSS order tricks are needed.

SeeInAction has two buttons (the thumbnail and 'Watch Live Demo') that do the same thing. That is fine for usability, but the thumbnail button has aria-label 'Watch the live demo' and the other button has the visible text 'Watch Live Demo', so screen readers hear the same action twice.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Set localStorage hasSeenVisitorAuth=true. Use wait_until='domcontentloaded' because networkidle times out (the live preview recomputes on a timer and there is background polling). The testimonial carousel auto-rotates every 6s, so check prev/next quickly. The 'how-it-works' nav item sits inside the Resources dropdown, not the top nav.
